title.narrative: Karamoja Greenbelt's Women Led Large Scale Farming of Cereals, Legumes and Oilseed

description.narrative: This project seeks to respond to chronic food insecurity in the Karamoja region, which is a result of combined pressures, including environmental degradation and climate change. Most people in Karamoja are facing food shortages, either year-long or seasonal, and the region has been exposed to increasing droughts.
